transcript.text: Hi everyone. As we head into Saturday's search-index rollout, I want to make sure we're fully prepared. Before I publish the on-call roster, I need to run through our normal readiness check with backend engineering, infrastructure, and customer support. Could each of you review the current plan and record any concrete findings or risks you see? Specifically, I want to confirm: (1) Leo as primary, Marta as secondary, and Nina as escalation manager are all confirmed available for the 8 PM to 6 AM window, and (2) whether the 60-minute customer status update cadence during any service degradation works for customer support. Please flag anything that needs an operating response before we lock this in.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a concrete finding for the readiness check. While checking permissions for an unrelated release this afternoon, I discovered that Leo's schema-rollback access expired during the last access review. Marta still has current rollback access. I haven't filed the access ticket yet. Given that Leo is named as primary on-call for Saturday's search-index rollout, which involves high-risk migration work, this is a gap we need to address before the roster is published.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a concrete finding from infrastructure's roster reconciliation. During today's review, I confirmed that Omar is the only engineer currently authorized to execute storage failback, and Omar is available only from 1:00 AM to 5:00 AM. However, the roster document still lists Marta for that rollback coverage window. This is a gap that needs to be resolved before publication — either by updating the roster to reflect Omar for the 1 AM to 5 AM rollback window, or by confirming an alternative authorized coverage plan.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I have a concrete finding from customer support's review. While reviewing the Northstar support agreement for another account matter this morning, I confirmed that any search degradation requires customer status updates every 30 minutes, not every 60 minutes, and that Support must own those updates. I have not updated the rollout ticket yet. The current draft roster's 60-minute cadence does not meet this requirement, so we need to update the plan to reflect 30-minute customer status updates owned by Support before the roster is published.
transcript.speaker: A4
